purpose: Teach: 別段/係り/入れ替わり/直轄/年俸/引上げ/支配人/バランスシート

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、別段の事案でないか確認されますね
lines.en: So the police are checking whether this might be a special case.
lines.style: Measured, slightly deferential. Thoughtful pace. Observing aloud, not interrogating. Warm respect underlying the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警備の係りを駐車場に増やされましたね
lines.en: And they've increased security patrols in the parking area.
lines.style: Continuing the same thread. Still calm and evenly paced. Light affirming nod in the voice. Building a picture of thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、勤務シフトの入れ替わりも厳格に管理されますね
lines.en: They're managing shift changes pretty strictly too.
lines.style: Steady, conversational. A small appreciative lift on 「厳格」—noticing the rigor. Still warm, not performative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本部直轄の特捜部署のお話、頼もしいです
lines.en: The fact that HQ has a dedicated task force on this—that's reassuring.
lines.style: Slightly warmer here. Genuine relief in the phrasing. Respectful tone. A beat of real feeling after careful observation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警官の年俸改善も検討されてますね
lines.en: And they're actually looking into improving the salary situation for younger officers too.
lines.style: Surprised, in a positive way. Slight emphasis on 「改善」—appreciating the scope of what's being addressed. Still measured, not emphatic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、給与引上げの世論にもご対応中ですね
lines.en: They're responding to the public pressure about wages as well.
lines.style: Nodding along. Admiring the political awareness. Calm and even. A touch of dry warmth—recognizing realpolitik without cynicism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ビルの支配人とも情報交換されますね
lines.en: They're keeping the building management in the loop too.
lines.style: Slightly more direct. Noticing the coordination. Clear, steady. Not rushed. The picture getting clearer, more comprehensive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、組織のバランスシート的な人員配置を考えていらっしゃるんですね
lines.en: It sounds like they're thinking about this with real structural care—like a proper balance sheet for personnel.
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful. A moment of genuine recognition. Slower pace, deliberate word choice. Respect settling in. Slight trailing-off on the final image, like something has clicked into place.
